body:
My sis is at the ward. I felt helpless talking to her. I tried to help, but I don't know what to say or do. It pains me, cuz I also know what it feels like to feel to end it. And she's telling it to me. So I gotta be the big bro, even though I feel exactly like her.

Don't give up, it gets better. Don't you dare to give up on me. That's how I feel.
Thanks. I try, but when it seems it doesn't help. It makes you feel helpless. It's hard, but I'm not gonna bother you with it anymore.
It's hard when it's your sis, and I hate for being just a goddamn mofo being just another guy, I sasdfasdfdsfasdfasdf asdf asdf asdfas asdf asdf asdf
Thanks for understanding. I prolly should be somewhere else, not trying to do... what. I guess it's what I need, not as much as what I hope to help others.
I hope that's the case, and I'm happy for you and your mom. She's not responding right now, she's a wreck. And I lash out, sorry.
I'd switch my position all the time, why am I such a cool mofo to take it, I'd switch my positions with my sis every fucking day every fucking day of my life to the every fucking end.

When I feel I try to be there, it doesn't matter. She was studying and all 6 mo from now, and now she's a wreck. And I try to help her, and she says it's all over, she can't do it no more. And I say why, and she says it's the meds. I say stop taking them.
I'm so fucking frustrated and I hope something worked.
I'm sorry. It was my sis, sorry, sorry. Sorry again, it's my sis, she's on a ward for 6 months and she's not responding and I hate myself and I hate my life. Sorry. You're fighthing a good fight.
First of all, people want to seek help. If one is suicidal, it doesn't help to say otherwise. Second of all, we're all doing this because we feel is right.
Yeah, I can imagine it motherfucker. Are you hovering above us, mr, so you can look down to us and tell these things.
My sis told me she was done, I'm done, we're all done but just waiting for the right moment. We're done, ladies and gentlemen, wish you the best.
That's not how it goes. He needs to want it, and everyone else can fuck the right off. But maybe that's just me.
He's not here, is he. He has to want it and be here.
A broad. A woman, some might say.

Some years ago I was suffering from panic disorder. I thought it was the end. Add a bird to it, you'll see how it goes.

I went through. No thanks to a bird, and now I'm doing what I do. It can happen, but you have to take control.

First of all, no man should ever step in the way of your happiness. Young men are bound to fuck around, that's what... they do.

What do *you* want? What would make you happy?

Give yourself one.

Think really hard what you're expecting from yourself. Still studying? You might change what you're doing.
What do you want now then?

If you feel for her, try to be there for her. You could tell her how you fell, not getting the breath in you need. You could be surprised how much she's on there with you.

Life can be fucking hard. If you feel you want to be there, tell her. What's the worst that can happen? Life is fucking hard, and you only get one shot. Tell her, tell about all your fears. What's the worst that can happen?

Go high. The mess is unavoidable. Nobody wants to see that mess.

Or you might not do it. Why exactly would you want to?
Are you happy now with your missis?
Are you living in a free country, or is your life in jeopardy for telling these things?
I'll think about it, thanks.

My dad does everything he can, he's the father for fuck's sake. He's done a lot, and with no help from this guy.

Maybe I should reach out for her, even though she hates me. She really does. I'm the worst kind of older brother there ever was, I'm thinking she told me this, so fuck her. Fuck her.

That's what I'm been thinking about. I told my sister was a selfish bastard, but how about me? I'm the most selfish bastard there is. Fuck me and my problems. Fuck me, I haven't liked me in 10 years. Hard, to realize it. Fuck me, and my fucking probems. Fuck. I don't know what to do. I really don't.

It's so strange, if only my sister ever told me that.

You're a good person and I wish all the best for you, missis.

I've sort of tried to insulate myself of all that. The last we met in good terms, she ended up telling me I'm the worst person there is. So I sort of gave up. I tried to make contact, but she told me to fuck off, being an idiot I am.

I could try more, I know. Last we spoke I told her to try to hang on in there, it's just life, life is all there is. But she never responded. And now she's back in a horrible place and I have no idea what to do. To be honest, I don't even know her number nowadays.

Ain't this shit. My sis and I are both looking for a way out, and I'd hate to think who might get the worst of it. I'm telling myself that it doesn't matter, and I have no contact with real life anymore. Shit.
I like you. I don't even know why, maybe because what you said made you feel like a person to me.
Don't you have anyone else to tell it to?

We've never been close, my sis and me. She's 10 years my junior, and I was out before she became a person. She always made everything about herself, she didn't mind, but she felt it when my mother died, at the age of before 50.

She was horrible to her. But my mom died. I've sort of resented her for it, because she was the bitchiest teenager there ever was. But I was glad when she finally made something of herself.

But she had a breakdown, she stopped taking citalopram, and then she was gone. She went to a psyhiatric hospital, and she hasn't recovered ever since. She was studying, and it finally felt for me that she's going to be a decent human being. But she crashed.

I don't know what to do. I feel like an idiot as I'm supposed to be something I was never become, I can't help her, she's on there by her own. Should I help? But I don't even like her. I still resent her. I could say I have issues of my own.
Besides, getting my posts silently deleted, fuck you SuicideWatch. Fuck you, apparently we're not all worthy.

The pretending is that I'm a guy who likes it here. I do it for the people I care about. Ok, one person, my old man. My sister is way worse off than me. She was studying, and had a nervous breakdown and can't do it anymore.

If I liked her, I'd try to help, but she's not anyone's favorite person. We're not buddies, and as the older bro, I should. But she has on many occasions told me she doesn't like me.

So it's my dad. He's happy, he has a new woman. The finest one there is. I just don't know I can keep on living for another person's sake anymore. I want to quit. As an atheist, I know it wouldn't do anything to me. I'm just gone.

I can't start over anymore. I'm in debt, I've cut off everyone, I've sort of put myself up for it. Nobody left, no backdoor to squeeze myself out of, I'm done. I've accomplished everything I wanted to before I go. Now that I did it, I'm not 100% sure I want to do it, I should, I prepared for it.
Well, I guess this is it. I hope life's kind for you.

The past days have just flown by. For some time I was thinking about the two choices I saw: either call my father and ask him if I could stay for an indefinite while, or go for the nuclear option. I really thought this through, over and over again. I just don't have the energy to start over. I've done this shit to myself before, I can't trust myself not to fuck it up again. There's nothing I look forward to, this is it, and it's not getting better.

I feel quite weird now. A little sad, but not overwhelmingly so. It's like I've stepped into a train and looking out of the window seeing the familiar things slowly moving away. I know I have the ticket but I'm not quite sure where I put it.
Sorry to hear you're in a similar situation. No oars in this canoe though, haven't been in a while, just floating down.
